exposure: Etiology of PRAKI (e.g., severe preeclampsia, sepsis, HELLP, Abruption)
outcome: Chronic kidney disease (mentioned as lasting impact)
cohort: The study included 19 women diagnosed with Pregnancy-related acute kidney injury (PRAKI) according to KDIGO criteria, admitted to the Institute of Obstetrics and Gynecology in Chennai during 2019, selected from 16,469 deliveries.
finding: The incidence of PRAKI was 11.5 per 10,000 admissions, predominantly affecting primigravida women aged 20-25 years in the postpartum period, with severe preeclampsia and sepsis being the most frequent underlying causes leading to an alarmingly high maternal mortality rate of 57.9% and fetal loss of 43.75%.
mod_finding: The study included mode of delivery as a variable to analyze but did not report specific findings related to it in the abstract.
gest_age: All women with a diagnosis of PRAKI were included, irrespective of gestational age.
